links.label: Picflow vs. Pixieset
links.description: Picflow is collaboration-first (comments, on-image annotations, approval statuses) for fast client reviews. Pixieset is sales-first with a built-in store and photographer websites.

links.label: Picflow vs. SmugMug
links.description: Picflow focuses on proofing and delivery for creative teams. SmugMug centers on portfolio hosting and e-commerce/print sales.

links.label: Picflow vs. PhotoShelter
links.description: Picflow streamlines client review/approvals; PhotoShelter adds selling and licensing tools alongside client delivery/DAM features.

links.label: Picflow vs. Frame.io
links.description: Picflow gives designers and clients a simple shared gallery for both images and video review. Frame.io is specialized for video teams with deep Adobe Creative Cloud integration and pro workflows.

links.label: Picflow vs. Pic-Time
links.description: Picflow prioritizes feedback and approvals; Pic-Time emphasizes client galleries with a strong print store and sales automations.

links.label: Picflow vs. Filestage
links.description: Picflow is a lightweight, client-friendly proofing gallery. Filestage is more complex and less intuitive with staged workflows.

links.label: Picflow vs. Ziflow
links.description: Picflow simplifies reviews in branded galleries; Ziflow targets approval for governance and compliance.

links.label: Picflow vs. Air.inc
links.description: Picflow is for sharing, proofing, and delivering assets to clients. Air is a more technical DAM-style for managing assets in campaigns.
